name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter's strategic mind was honed not on the racetrack initially, but in the complex world of engineering simulations. A graduate of RWTH Aachen University, he initially worked on optimizing aerodynamic performance for automotive manufacturers. However, the allure of motorsport, with its real-time decision-making and high stakes, proved irresistible. He transitioned into motorsport, first as a data analyst, quickly rising through the ranks due to his exceptional ability to identify critical performance advantages hidden within complex data sets. 

At Herberth Motorsport, Klaus is known for his meticulous preparation and his calm demeanor even under immense pressure. He believes that a winning strategy is built on a foundation of thorough analysis, understanding the limitations of the equipment, and anticipating the actions of competitors. He's a firm believer in the power of simulation to predict outcomes and is constantly seeking new ways to leverage technology to gain an edge. What sets Klaus apart is his uncanny ability to make bold strategic calls that often defy conventional wisdom, leading to surprising and successful results.

physical.description: Klaus is a lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of imported German mineral water available at all times.
